title: Edge count of a $k$-edge-connected graph
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph with vertex set $V$ and edge set $E$, and let $\kappa'(G)$ denote its edge connectivity. For every natural number $k$ with $k \le \kappa'(G)$, \[ k\,\abs{V} \le 2\abs{E}. \]
replaced:
A \texttt{k}-edge-connected graph satisfies \texttt{k$\nu$ $\le$ 2$\varepsilon$}.

3.1.2 Show that if $G$ is $k$-edge-connected, then $\varepsilon \ge k\nu/2$.
